name: ln
summary: Create hard or symbolic links (-s symbolic, -f replace)

options.description: accepted and ignored (no backups are made)
replace an existing file of the same name
a hard link to a symbolic link links what it points to
treat a link to a directory as a file when it is the destination
a hard link to a symbolic link links the link itself (the default)
with -s, store the target relative to the link's directory
create symbolic links rather than hard ones
treat the last operand as the link's name, never a directory
